phase_fields.description: Size of the phase fields to rank: ternary = 3 elements (e.g. Li Mg O), quaternary = 4 elements (e.g. Li Mg S O). Quinary cannot be ranked.

cation1_test.description: Elements for position 1 (cation) of the phase fields to rank, e.g. Li. Each phase field takes one element from each position list, all different

cation2_test.description: Elements for position 2 (second cation), e.g. Mg, Al. Used for quaternary, and for ternary when nanions_train is 1

anion1_test.description: Elements for the first anion position, e.g. O, S. Always used

anion2_test.description: Elements for the second anion position, e.g. O, S. Used for quaternary, and for ternary when nanions_train is 0 or 2

icsd_file.description: Training data: the bundled ICSD-derived list of known compositions with oxidation states (icsd2017)

cations_train.description: Cations allowed in the training phase fields: 'all', or element symbols separated by commas, e.g. Li, Na, Mg

anions_train.description: Anions (elements with a negative oxidation state) allowed in the training phase fields, e.g. O, S, F

nanions_train.description: Minimum number of anions (from anions_train) in each training phase field; 0 ignores oxidation states. For ternary, 1 ranks cation-cation-anion fields and 0 or 2 rank cation-anion-anion fields

features.description: Elemental feature set used to describe each element (magpie is the default)

method.description: Unsupervised model: VAE / AE (PyOD) or VAE_encoder (Keras VAE with latent features)

cross_validate.description: Also run 5-fold cross-validation of the model (needs at least 5 training phase fields; slower)

average_runs.description: Number of training runs to average the scores over (at least 1)

rank.description: Train an unsupervised model on ICSD phase-field patterns and rank the requested unexplored phase fields by similarity to known chemistry (likelihood of hosting a stable compound). The study is defined by the model parameters.

rankings.csv.description: Ranked phase fields with raw and normalised similarity scores

top_ranked.description: Most-promising phase fields (lowest score = most similar to known chemistry)

score.description: Reconstruction-error score (lower = more similar to ICSD)
